title: Select and recover the kiosk camera
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-002 RED: no camera list/preview/selection exists; GREEN: the configuration UI lists understandable browser-visible devices, previews and remembers an explicit selection, downscales above-site-maximum input before downstream buffer work, and after disconnect/reconnect/USB-port move keeps advertising usable and requires explicit reselection rather than arbitrary substitution; decisive comparison: fake/real media fixtures inspect labels, preview, persisted selection, input dimensions and recovery state; artifact: Playwright transcript under .tasks/TASK-061-T2-FT-003-W2/.
purpose: Own recoverable camera discovery, preview, explicit selection and input downscale independently of static shell delivery.
success_outcome: Operators can select and recover the intended camera without interrupting advertising or silently switching devices.
anti_goals: Do not serve the client shell or implement ring buffer/capture.
Do not hard-code a camera model or arbitrary fallback.
Do not mutate server state from camera configuration.

forbidden_scope: Static shell delivery owned by TASK-044-T2-FT-003-W1
Named degraded-state composition owned by TASK-055-T2-FT-003-W7
stop_conditions: Browser-visible camera enumeration/preview cannot be proved in managed Chromium.

constraints: Use installed playwright cli with fake media plus managed Chromium device fixtures.
Exact site maximum remains deployment configuration.
Persist selection in managed kiosk profile and apply from next Attempt.
invariants: Unavailable selected camera never triggers arbitrary substitution.
Advertising stays usable while explicit reselection is required.
Oversized input is downscaled before ring-buffer/detector work.
verification_targets: Oversized-input dimension proof before downstream seam.
